scene.title: Finance asks: can we cut the cost of classifying 10,000 overnight tickets?
scene.sceneHtml:
TicketFlow: Week 3

Product wants overnight batch processing: classify 10,000 tickets that came in after hours. Real-time API would cost $X. Finance asks: can we cut that cost? You discover the Batch API: 50% savings for async workloads with flexible completion windows.

takeaways: Message Batches API: up to 10K requests per batch, async, 50% lower token cost; poll batches.retrieve() until processing_status is "ended".
Use Batch for overnight jobs, backfills and bulk work with a flexible window of hours; never for user-facing realtime responses.
Cost = volume x avg input tokens x input price + volume x avg output tokens x output price; then 50% off for batch, 90% off cached tokens.
Exam trap: output tokens count too. When spend grows unexplained, add per-feature token tracking from message.usage before optimizing.
